limitations.cursor: Cursor ~/.cursor/mcp.json has no documented disabled/lazy field. Live file receives Core CS-kit HTTP remotes plus general HTTP. Full/Heavy (hexstrike-ai, metasploit, sliver, sliver-full, cloud-audit) stay in generated/cursor-mcp-full-heavy.json because hexstrike tool-schema dumps have OOM'd Cursor (G-15/G-18) and Cursor merge retires hexstrike-ai. Stdio-only general fleet is not copied into Cursor.
limitations.claude-json: Live ~/.claude.json is rewritten by Claude processes. Canonical Claude Code catalog is ~/.mcp.json. This reconciler only converts existing CS-kit keys in ~/.claude.json to shared HTTP; it does not inject the full general list there.
limitations.grok: No user-level Grok MCP registry found. ~/.grok marketplace-cache mcp-servers.json is a template pack, not a live catalog. Projection written to generated/grok-mcp.json.
limitations.agy-private-mcp: AGENTS.md forbids a private ~/.agy/mcp.json. Agy/Gemini uses ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (serverUrl + disabled).
limitations.stdio-lazy: Stdio-only general servers stay resident in Claude ~/.mcp.json (already present) and the SSOT list. Clients without a disabled/lazy stdio gate do not receive new stdio registrations.
limitations.goose: Goose ~/.config/goose/config.yaml extensions support streamable_http + enabled. CS-kit and general HTTP remotes are attached; bundled platform/builtin extensions are left untouched.
limitations.continue: Continue ~/.continue/config.json has models/contextProviders only — no MCP server map. Schema limitation; no fake mcpServers block.
